title: feat(ui-types): filter-builder number bucket follows the spec numeric value family (progress, slider, summary)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu76CdcjMmgYPLs3UuMF1RMq)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：控制台筛选器的「数字类字段」清单不再手抄四个类型，直接取自 spec 的数字值族 `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES`，于是 progress、slider、summary 三类字段也拿到「大于 / 小于 / ≥ / ≤」，不再出现服务端会拒收的「包含 / 开头是」。
- 为什么改：按裁决 C 执行。进度字段在列表筛选里只能选文本条件，服务端一律 400，用户想要的「进度大于 50%」在界面上建不出来。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽不收紧，`@object-ui/types` 的筛选字段 `type` 多接受三个值，原来接受的都照旧；回滚就是 revert 这一个 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/types/src/filter-field-types.ts`（数字桶的来源改为 spec 集合）、`ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.ts`（钉住「数字桶 = spec 数字值族」）、`.changeset/27497-filter-number-bucket-spec-numeric.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.ts examples/schema-catalog/test/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.tsx`，预期两个文件全绿，其中 progress、slider、summary 各有一行「拿到与 number 相同的条件、没有文本条件」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27497
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` or `ui/skills/**` teaches the filter-builder field-type list (a search for `filter-builder`, `FilterField` and `FILTER_NUMBER` there returns nothing)

## What changes

- `FILTER_NUMBER_LIKE_TYPES` in `@object-ui/types` is now taken from `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), the set the server's filter doors use to read a field as numeric. It was a hand-kept list of four (`number`, `currency`, `percent`, `rating`). It now also carries `slider`, `progress` and `summary`, and a type the spec adds to that set later joins on its own.
- `FILTER_FIELD_TYPES`, `FilterFieldSchema.type` (the `./zod` entry) and `FilterFieldType` follow from it as before, so the published accept set widens by those three members. Nothing that was accepted before is refused.
- `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES` is a read-only set of strings, so its members cannot be read as literals at compile time. The type face therefore names the family as a literal union beside the derived value, and a pin holds that union equal to the spec set (an exhaustive `Record` plus a runtime key comparison).
- `filter-builder.tsx` is not touched. Every operator and value-control branch reads the shared bucket by membership, so no renderer branch was missing. The per-member render measurement in the schema-catalog mirror covers the three new members on its own.
- Changeset: `minor` on `@object-ui/types`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.ts`: a new block pins `FILTER_NUMBER_LIKE_TYPES` equal to `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES` member for member, pins the type face's literal union equal to the same set, and checks that `FilterFieldSchema` accepts each spec numeric type.
- `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.tsx`: a new block checks that every number-bucket member, `progress` among them, gets exactly the operators `operatorsForFieldType('number')` gets, including `greater_than`, and none of `contains`, `icontains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with` or `ends_with`.

## Acceptance notes

- Server acceptance was measured live, not read from code. The stock showcase ran from this branch's build (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on a random port). Numeric comparisons answer 200 on all three types, and `contains` answers 400 on all three. Readings are below.
- `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/config/view-config-utils.ts` `normalizeFieldType` keeps its own numeric spelling list, which also leaves out `progress`, `slider` and `summary`. This was read, not reproduced, and it is outside this card's file surface, so it is noted here and not fixed.
- `ui/packages/components/docs/FilterBuilder.md` still lists `type?: string` as five spellings. That was already stale before this change. Not edited here.

## Verification

<details><summary>Server acceptance (showcase, fresh DB, this branch's build)</summary>

```
showcase_task ["progress",">",50]            -> 200 total 5
showcase_task ["progress",">","50"]          -> 200
showcase_task ["progress",">=",50]           -> 200
showcase_task ["progress","<=",50]           -> 200
showcase_task ["progress","contains","4"]    -> 400 (text operator $contains at a declared progress field)
showcase_field_zoo ["f_slider",">",10]       -> 200 total 1
showcase_field_zoo ["f_slider","<=",10]      -> 200 total 1
showcase_field_zoo ["f_slider","contains","6"] -> 400 (text operator at a declared slider field)
showcase_invoice ["total",">",0]             -> 200 total 4   (total is Field.summary)
showcase_invoice ["total","<",100000000]     -> 200 total 12
showcase_invoice ["total","contains","1"]    -> 400 (text operator at a declared summary field)
showcase_expense_report ["total_amount",">=",0] -> 200 total 4 (summary)
```
No type was excluded: the server takes numeric comparisons on every member of the family.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation and reverse verification (one-off, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

- Ablation, dropping one member: the derivation was mutated to filter out `slider` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 2af20a77c320 to c231fbe12b53). The two mirror files then gave Test Files 1 failed, with `FILTER_NUMBER_LIKE_TYPES equals NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES, member for member` and `accepts the spec numeric type slider` red. The file was restored to its HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- Reverse verification of the type face: adding `formula` to the exhaustive record fails `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` with TS2353 (`'formula' does not exist` on the record keyed by `SpecNumericValueType`). The file was restored to its HEAD blob. The first attempt used an anchor contained in its own replacement. ablation-replace refused it as a no-op, and the run was redone with a disjoint anchor.
</details>
